comment: WineMetalGL game corpus. Binaries, traces and reference frames live under --corpus-root (see README.md); only this manifest is tracked. 'reference' reuses another entry's reference frames when that entry must render the same image.

entries.name: scene33-core
entries.notes: GL 3.3 core forward-compatible: UBO camera, instancing, mipmaps, RGBA16F + depth FBO, post pass, point sprites, orphaned stream VBO.

entries.name: scene33-core-30
entries.notes: 30-frame variant; its last frame is the reference for scene33-trace.

entries.name: scene33-core-nofwd
entries.notes: Same scene from a core context that is not forward-compatible (stock winemac refuses this). Apple's OpenGL has no such context, so it has no Apple timing.

entries.name: scene33-compat
entries.notes: Same scene from a 3.3 compatibility-profile context, which Apple's OpenGL cannot provide.

entries.name: scene33-trace
entries.notes: apitrace capture of scene33-core (30 frames) replayed with glretrace; checks the trace path end to end.

entries.name: scene4x-core41
entries.notes: GL 4.1 core forward-compatible: tessellated terrain (control and evaluation shaders) from an indirect draw, a double-precision wave height, a geometry shader with two invocations writing gl_ViewportIndex into a two-viewport array, subroutine shading, RGBA16F + depth target, tonemap pass.

entries.name: scene4x-core42
entries.notes: The same frame from a 4.2 core context, tonemapped through image stores counted by an atomic counter (GL 4.2, beyond Apple's OpenGL) and displayed by a second pass.

entries.name: legacy-gl21
entries.notes: GL 1.x/2.x fixed-function frame from wglCreateContext: two lights with specular materials, display lists, immediate mode, client arrays with glDrawElements(GL_QUADS), multitexture, sphere-map texgen, linear fog, alpha test, clip plane, point sprites, glBitmap text, glDrawPixels, glPushAttrib. Apple's OpenGL runs it and records the reference.

entries.name: legacy-gl21-i386
entries.notes: The same frame from a 32-bit (WoW64) process.

entries.name: legacy-compat33
entries.notes: The same fixed-function frame from a 3.3 compatibility-profile context, which Apple's OpenGL cannot provide.
